periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique vertical orientation, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the visual mass concentrated in the lower half forming a teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark shoulder band occupies approximately 40% of the visible torso height before transitioning to the lighter abdominal fur.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large separation, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, linear vertical object (stem or bamboo shoot) is held in the mouth and extends downward across the center of the chest.
